assumptions: Runtime is usable energy divided by work system power, and the adjusted input does not change usable energy.
Work power falls by 5 W for each ampere removed from pi_work_current_a (declared supply voltage).
Exported values are rounded to the declared resolution; the bound takes the least favourable rounding.
Other checks reading this input (for example source margin) are not predicted here; HS must rerun them.
applied_candidates.basis: HS models Fielddeck work power as supply_voltage_v x (Pi + keyboard + fan current) + display power with supply_voltage_v = 5 V (design.json engineering_assumptions), and runtime as usable bank energy / work power. pi_work_current_a is the only HS-adjustable input with room to move runtime (keyboard_current_a is 0.1 A with a 0.02 A floor); bank capacity is fixed in the design and is not an HS revision input. The minimum is HS's registered lower bound for pi_work_current_a.
applied_candidates.explanation: Modelled: pi_work_current_a 1 -> 0.697 A lowers work power to about 5.735 W for a predicted lower-bound runtime of at least 4 h. Unverified until HS reruns the study.
applied_candidates.formula: E_min = (R - r/2) x (P - r/2); P_required = E_min / T; dI = (P + r/2 - P_required) / V; I_after = floor((I_before - dI) / step) x step
applied_candidates.label: Modelled candidate design change, not a fix. HS must rerun its native study; no physical behaviour is established.
